name: Fine-Tuning Decision Kit 📊
description_md:
# What You Get

- Copy-paste Quarterly Review Checklist to pressure-test if your fine-tune still makes sense.

- Two Mermaid flowcharts (1:1 and 16:9) mapping the “Should You Fine-Tune?” decision tree—color-coded and export-ready from mermaid.live.

- 
API vs Open Source vs On-Prem branches with cost/scale gates (tokens/month, devops needs, compliance triggers).

- 
Implementation notes (QLoRA/PEFT, Axolotl, RunPod/Vast) and monitoring prompts for drift, updates, and fallbacks.

- 
Plug-and-play: drop into docs, slides, Notion, or Miro; print-friendly and editable text.

Join my Early AI-dopters Community — you won’t regret it 😉 https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
